text: The **never-touched product tail** (Cashu / WoT / Blossom-complete — pure post-v1 features with no near-term detail). For *those only*, a single "Post-v1 product roadmap" checklist issue is defensible minimalism — they're not being worked, not agent-bound, and a `- [ ]` list is more honest than 7 stubs aging for months. The cost is losing their existing evidence-rich bodies, and re-expanding when one goes active. I would **not** do this for any arch/debt/reconcile item — those must stay discrete because agents and PRs attach to them imminently.
